```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Create a bar chart to show the survival ratio by sex
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.countplot(x='sex', data=data, hue='survived', palette='viridis')
plt.title('Survival Ratio by Sex')
plt.xlabel('Sex')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.legend(title='Survived')
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
